_comment: Field names and types come from object_definition.json, shared with SOAP.
recordType: REST record type whose metadata lists custom fields.
recordTypes: list form of recordType, for tables spanning several record types (Items).
lineSign: -1 where SuiteQL stores line amounts negated (sales transactions).

fields: how to read each catalog field in SuiteQL, keyed by displayName (kind: column, ref, mainlineRef, joinColumn, customFields, transactionLines, unsupported; optional: null instead of failing when the account can't read it).
_transactionLineFields: [SOAP line field, transactionline column, kind] for item lists.
_transactionLineFieldsNote: best-effort mapping from NetSuite docs; not verified against SOAP output
